audit_fields_bounded.name: audit_fields_bounded
audit_fields_bounded.value: length("audit_logs"."actor") BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND length("audit_logs"."action") BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND length("audit_logs"."resource") BETWEEN 1 AND 80

requests_text_limits.name: requests_text_limits
requests_text_limits.value: length("customer_requests"."product_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length("customer_requests"."variant_label") <= 200 AND ("customer_requests"."comment" IS NULL OR length("customer_requests"."comment") <= 1000)

attempt_outcome_valid.name: attempt_outcome_valid
attempt_outcome_valid.value: ("payment_attempts"."status"='PENDING' AND "payment_attempts"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "payment_attempts"."provider" IS NULL AND "payment_attempts"."provider_payment_id" IS NULL) OR ("payment_attempts"."status" IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED') AND "payment_attempts"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_attempts"."provider" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_attempts"."provider_payment_id" IS NOT NULL)

variants_text_valid.name: variants_text_valid
variants_text_valid.value: ("product_variants"."size" IS NULL OR length(btrim("product_variants"."size")) BETWEEN 1 AND 40) AND ("product_variants"."color" IS NULL OR length(btrim("product_variants"."color")) BETWEEN 1 AND 40) AND ("product_variants"."sku" IS NULL OR length(btrim("product_variants"."sku")) BETWEEN 1 AND 100)

products_price_valid.name: products_price_valid
products_price_valid.value: "products"."base_price" BETWEEN 0 AND 99999999.99 AND ("products"."old_price" IS NULL OR ("products"."old_price" > "products"."base_price" AND "products"."old_price" <= 99999999.99))

contacts_phone_valid.name: contacts_phone_valid
contacts_phone_valid.value: ("shop_contacts"."phone" IS NULL OR "shop_contacts"."phone" ~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{7,14}$') AND ("shop_contacts"."whatsapp_phone" IS NULL OR "shop_contacts"."whatsapp_phone" ~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{7,14}$')

generated.as: CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL THEN ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(longitude::double precision, latitude::double precision),4326) ELSE NULL END

locations_address_valid.name: locations_address_valid
locations_address_valid.value: length(btrim("shop_locations"."address")) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND length("shop_locations"."city") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND ("shop_locations"."mall" IS NULL OR length(btrim("shop_locations"."mall")) BETWEEN 1 AND 150)

locations_coordinates_valid.name: locations_coordinates_valid
locations_coordinates_valid.value: ("shop_locations"."latitude" IS NULL AND "shop_locations"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("shop_locations"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "shop_locations"."longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "shop_locations"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "shop_locations"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

locations_2gis_valid.name: locations_2gis_valid
locations_2gis_valid.value: ("shop_locations"."two_gis_url" IS NULL AND "shop_locations"."two_gis_firm_id" IS NULL) OR ("shop_locations"."two_gis_url" IS NOT NULL AND "shop_locations"."two_gis_firm_id" IS NOT NULL AND "shop_locations"."two_gis_url" ~ '^https://2gis[.]kz/karaganda/firm/[0-9]{10,20}$' AND "shop_locations"."two_gis_url" = 'https://2gis.kz/karaganda/firm/' || "shop_locations"."two_gis_firm_id")

subscription_period_valid.name: subscription_period_valid
subscription_period_valid.value: ("subscriptions"."period_start" IS NULL AND "subscriptions"."period_end" IS NULL AND "subscriptions"."anchor_day" IS NULL) OR ("subscriptions"."period_start" IS NOT NULL AND "subscriptions"."period_end" IS NOT NULL AND "subscriptions"."anchor_day" IS NOT NULL AND "subscriptions"."period_end" > "subscriptions"."period_start" AND "subscriptions"."anchor_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 31)

subscription_paid_status_period.name: subscription_paid_status_period
subscription_paid_status_period.value: "subscriptions"."status" NOT IN ('ACTIVE','PAST_DUE','GRACE') OR ("subscriptions"."period_start" IS NOT NULL AND "subscriptions"."period_end" IS NOT NULL)

subscription_state_dates.name: subscription_state_dates
subscription_state_dates.value: ("subscriptions"."status"<>'GRACE' OR "subscriptions"."grace_ends_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("subscriptions"."status"<>'PAST_DUE' OR "subscriptions"."next_payment_at" IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT "subscriptions"."cancel_at_period_end" OR NOT "subscriptions"."auto_renew")
